children: U S GLOBAL INVESTORS reported net income of $3.1 million, or $0.24 per share, for the fiscal year ended June 30, 2026, reversing a prior-year loss. Total operating revenue for the year was $10.3 million, a 21% increase versus the prior year. The company cited higher net investment income and growth in assets under management as drivers of the improvement.
Operating Revenues: $10,251 thousand for the 12 months ended 6/30/2026 (vs. $8,452 thousand for 6/30/2025).
Operating Income (Loss): $(603) thousand for the 12 months ended 6/30/2026 (vs. $(2,986) thousand for 6/30/2025).
Total Other Income: $4,487 thousand for the 12 months ended 6/30/2026 (vs. $2,724 thousand for 6/30/2025).
Net Income: $3,055 thousand (Net income) for the 12 months ended 6/30/2026 (vs. $(334) thousand loss for 6/30/2025).
Net Income Per Share (Basic and Diluted): $0.24 for the 12 months ended 6/30/2026 (vs. $(0.03) for 6/30/2025).
Average assets under management (AUM) rose to $1.5 billion for the fiscal year ended 6/30/2026, up from $1.4 billion the prior year; total AUM at period-end was $1.7 billion (up from $1.3 billion).
Net investment income increased to $4.1 million for fiscal 2026, which included a non-cash net gain of approximately $3.2 million on equity securities carried under the measurement alternative.
Advisory fees from U.S. Global Investors Funds jumped to $3.8 million, driven by higher average AUM in gold and natural resources funds and the elimination of a prior-year performance fee adjustment.
ETF advisory fees were $6.2 million; the U.S. Global Jets ETF saw lower average net assets while the actively managed WAR ETF grew to $41.3 million in assets after launching in December 2024.

Share repurchase activity included 733,848 shares repurchased during the fiscal year at a cost of approximately $2.0 million; approximately $4.1 million remained available for repurchase under the 2026 authorization.
